_comment: Placeholder thresholds until NBG regulatory indicators are confirmed. Every report labels these as assumptions.

schedule._comment: Automated audits at daily slots, HH:MM in Tbilisi time (UTC+4). targets: all, or simulated (the organizers' mock only). Every slot set to all audits every target, real banks included (3 audits a day with the default slots); a slot that collides with a running audit is skipped. Without slots, timeTashkent (legacy) means one audit of all targets a day at that Tashkent time. manualRuns=false: no audits from the dashboard/API, only schedule and CLI. Disable with AUDIT_SCHEDULE_ENABLED=false.

monitor._comment: Continuous uptime monitor: one read-only request per target per interval (with the bank's test certificate when configured, so the answer is a real HTTP status). A failed sample is re-checked after confirmDownSec before it counts as down. Simulated targets (the mock only) also get a light authenticated AIS journey (accounts, balances, transactions) every authenticatedIntervalMin for the hour-of-day latency profile (0 = off). Disable with MONITOR_ENABLED=false.

alerts._comment: Telegram and email alerts, evaluated from the database every pollSec. Needs at least one channel in the environment (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN + TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, or SMTP_HOST + ALERT_EMAIL_TO). Latency alerts when the median of HTTP-answered monitor samples over latencyWindowMin exceeds latencyAlertMs (a median threshold, separate from the p95 indicator latencyP95Ms; latencyP95Ms is used when latencyAlertMs is unset). auditFinished: one summary per finished audit (scores, failures, new high-severity failures per bank). Disable with ALERTS_ENABLED=false.
